company: TwentyTour runs free (tip-based) and private walking tours in Luxembourg, Aachen, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart, Bergen, Oslo, Innsbruck and Maastricht.
faq: Free tours are tip-based: guests pay what they think the tour was worth at the end, cash or card.
Free tours last about 2 hours and run in English; booking is through GetYourGuide, Viator, Civitatis or GuruWalk.
Luxembourg free tour meeting point: Place d'Armes, in front of the Cercle Cité building, 11:00 every day.
Bergen free tour meeting point: the Fish Market (Fisketorget), at the Torgallmenningen corner, 10:00 every day.
Düsseldorf free tour meeting point: Burgplatz, next to the Schlossturm, 14:00 every day.
Private tours are available in all cities and several languages; the price depends on group size, language and date and is quoted by the team.
Cancellations and changes of free tours are done in the platform where the tour was booked; cancelling is free up to 24 hours before the start.
Dogs are welcome on all outdoor tours. The tours are not wheelchair accessible in the old town of Luxembourg because of stairs.
